dict.string: Life380 uses your location to show your family where you are on the map. Your location is end-to-end encrypted and only visible to your family circles. You can pause sharing or reduce precision anytime in Settings.

Life380 uses background location to notify your family when you arrive or leave places, even when the app is closed. Your location is end-to-end encrypted and automatically deleted after your chosen retention period. You have full control over who sees your location.
Life380 uses background location to keep your family informed of your arrivals and departures. All location data is end-to-end encrypted and you can disable this anytime.
Life380 needs your precise location to share with your emergency contacts during an SOS alert.
Life380 needs your location to calculate accurate arrival time estimates for your family.
Life380 uses motion data to improve location accuracy and detect when you're driving, walking, or stationary.
Life380 uses Face ID to secure sensitive features like toggling location sharing and triggering emergency SOS alerts.
Life380 uses the camera to scan QR codes for quickly joining family circles.
Life380 sends notifications when family members arrive or leave places, and for emergency SOS alerts.
